title: Purple Bandhani Print Chiffon Anarkali Suit Set with Hand-Embroidered Neckline & Dupatta
color_custom: Deep purple bandhani print with pink, teal & gold accents
description:
Ira is another name for Goddess Saraswati – graceful purple bandhani for festive days.

Made to twirl. This deep purple chiffon Anarkali carries the classic bandhani pattern of Rajasthan – rows of tiny dots in lilac, teal and gold, with pink rosettes scattered across. The V-neckline is embroidered by hand with thread flowers and sequins, with a little sequin sparkle on the bodice. A fine wire is stitched into the hem, so the flare holds its soft, wavy ruffle with every step. Sheer full sleeves gather gently at the wrist, and a matching bandhani print chiffon dupatta completes the look.

✦ The Details
• V-neckline with hand embroidery – thread flowers and sequins
• Fitted bodice with a full, flowing Anarkali flare
• Wired hem for a soft, wavy ruffle that keeps its shape
• Sheer full sleeves gathered softly at the wrist
• Cotton lining, so it is never see-through and feels soft on the skin
• Matching purple cotton pants
• Bandhani print chiffon dupatta
• 3-piece set: Anarkali, pants and dupatta

✦ Fabric & Craft
Light, airy chiffon printed in a bandhani pattern, lined in soft cotton. The neckline is embroidered by hand, so tiny variations are part of its handmade character. The cotton pants keep you comfortable all day.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular fit through the bodice with a full flare below. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
Silver jhumkas, a small bindi and clear heels for a mehndi or sangeet; drape the dupatta around the neck like in our photos, or on one shoulder so the embroidered neckline stays visible. For Diwali or a festive dinner, add gold juttis and a potli bag. Abroad, a black or camel long coat looks stunning over deep purple.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
set_items: Anarkali Kurta (chiffon, cotton lining, hand-embroidered neckline, wired flared hem)
care: Dry clean only. Do not wring or crush the hem – the wire inside keeps its wave. Store folded loosely in a muslin cloth, with tissue over the embroidery.
